text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein to discuss with U.S. President Clinton means of overcoming crisis in Middle East peace, issues relating to Iraq.
- Cabinet discusses elections and taking steps to facilitate investments.
- King Hussein to have prostate surgery following talks in Washington.
- Prime Minister Majali stresses Jordan's support of Palestinians; PLO's Erekat says "situation is very dangerous because of Israeli policies".
- Wide administrative changes in Education Ministry to be announced soon.
- Government begins dealing with administrative reform and preparations for November elections; committee to be set up to handle elections and steps to minimise centralisation.
- Majali heading to Washington on Thursday to take part in U.S.-Jordanian talks.
- Israeli paper says Jordan renews demands that Israel return absentee property of Jordanians.
- Majali pledges support for judiciary to enable them to perform their role fully.
